findings.finding: The live page returns 200 and is indexable, but its canonical points to /services/aeo/ instead of its own ranking URL.
findings.migrationRule: Keep /services/aeo-services-in-mumbai/ as the protected public route and self-canonicalize it unless later Search Console evidence explicitly supports a different canonical strategy. Do not copy the source canonical mismatch.

findings.finding: The protected AEO route is published in WordPress REST but was not present in the discovered sitemap URL set during the baseline crawl.
findings.migrationRule: Include the protected AEO route in the new indexable sitemap unless an explicit approved SEO decision says otherwise.

findings.finding: The current route redirects through the non-www homepage before reaching the canonical www homepage, creating two redirect hops.
findings.migrationRule: If this legacy source is retained, normalize it to a single approved redirect hop. Do not copy the chain.

findings.finding: The published WordPress career page currently redirects directly to the homepage.
findings.migrationRule: Do not assume the homepage redirect is correct. Verify intended careers architecture before approving any redirect.

findings.finding: The sitemap crawl treated the KML resource like an HTML page and therefore reported missing title/H1.
findings.migrationRule: Classify non-HTML resources separately and never apply HTML title/H1 requirements to KML/XML/assets.
